_comment: Update this file whenever you upload a new APK/IPA to /app. Shown on GET /app.

items.text: Profile switch — save outgoing prefs before loading the new profile (fixes crossfade, when-queue-ends, and downloads bleeding between Andy/Laura)
Downloads list, settings, library, and home reload when Acting as changes; incoming profile’s offline queue resumes from server
Security #18 — LAN API writes require Basic auth or mobileApi token (opt-in allowOpenLanApi); stream/artwork require credentials, HMAC sig, or allowOpenLanMedia
Cloudflare tunnel trust — Cf-* headers honored only from loopback (cloudflared), blocking forged headers on port-forward
Alexa stream URLs signed; web console uses /api/media/sign for artwork and browser playback when media auth is enabled
Android downloads follow active profile — switching Andy/Laura hides the other profile’s downloads, pauses sync, and resumes when you switch back
Bug hunt stability — queue and Now Playing state use cross-process file locks; NP poll no longer writes on GET
Playlist reliability — atomic ServerPlaylists.xml and .m3u writes; Plex sync defers m3u until XML commits and prunes orphan files
Stop-after-N and sleep timer honored on skip; add-to-playlist dedupes tracks and updates track count
Room queue UX — add tracks to a speaker's shared up-next from search, albums, playlists, and Now Playing; approve kid-safe requests from Family
Now Playing shows household requests with requester names; parents can approve, remove, and reorder the room queue
Android and iOS: Add to room on search/album/playlist/NP; Family tab pending requests
Playlist sharing — share from playlist detail with household member picker; owner/shared badges on library tiles (web, Android, iOS)
Office Show and MSP streams show the correct room name in Now Playing instead of generic Alexa labels
Sharing a playlist sets visibility to shared so recipients see it in their scoped library
